entities.name: Ricardo Williams
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ricardo Williams Jr. is an American professional boxer. Williams won a Light Welterweight Silver Medal at the 2000 Olympic Games, and turned pro in the following year and was immediately dubbed as a future star in the sport and the best fighter to come out of the 2000 games.
